typedef unsigned long long ULL;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

LL num[maxn];

    LL tep = (num[pos] * pos) % MOD;
    tep = (tep + 1) % MOD;

        re = (re * tep) % MOD;
    return re;
}

        for (int i = 1; i < P; i++)
            tepre = (tepre * P) % MOD;
        cout << tepre << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    if (K == 1) {
        long long tepre = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= P; i++)
            tepre = (tepre * P) % MOD;
        cout << tepre << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < P; i++) {
        if (!vis[i]) {
            LL tepnum = 0;
            LL pos = i;
            while (!vis[pos]) {
                vis[pos] = 1;
                tepnum++;
                pos = (K * pos) % P;
            }
            num[tepnum]++;
        }
    }

    LL re = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < P; i++) {
        if (num[i]) {
            re = (re * getnum(i)) % MOD;
        }
    }

    cout << re << endl;
    return 0;
}
